scope_note: This is NOT a market backtest. Deflated-Sharpe / CSCV-PBO are market concepts and do NOT apply here. The multiplicity risk we control is the SELECTION-BIAS analogue: cherry-picking the best of several tried wheel-contract configurations, or running many comparisons against the null without correction. The decision variable is a deterministic census count D_marginal read from a frozen repository/build artifact, not a sampled return.

family.definition: The family of hypotheses = the set of tried wheel-contract configuration variants, each tested for MARGINAL detection over the preregistered null baseline (EXISTING_SUITE, the in-place gate suite). Every variant that could have been reported as the headline result is enumerated here, so no favourable run can be silently selected.
family.null_reference_rationale: Preregistered primary null (protocols/flagship_preregistration.yaml -> nulls.primary_null / nulls.null_reference): the pre-existing CI gate suite (import-linter, unit tests, release-gate probes) resolving imports IN PLACE on snapshot S. A defect is marginal ONLY if this reference misses it.

excluded_from_family.EXISTING_SUITE: It is the NULL reference the family is tested against, not itself a tested variant.

randomization_null.name: label-shuffle permutation null (SHUFFLED tier)
randomization_null.definition: Each imported first-party namespace label is replaced by a random draw from a stdlib token pool (fixed seed); the flagship detection rule is then applied. Because the stdlib pool contains ZERO first-party namespaces, every relabeling yields 0 first-party hits by construction.
randomization_null.analytic_note: Since every permutation statistic is deterministically 0, an observed statistic > 0 exceeds all B permutations -> p = (0 + 1)/(B + 1) = 1/10001; an observed statistic of 0 is tied with all B permutations -> p = (B + 1)/(B + 1) = 1.0. The p-values below are therefore exact, not Monte-Carlo estimates.

selection_count_definition: Number of comparisons made against the preregistered null = number of configuration variants tried (FLAGSHIP + NAIVE + ABLATED + SHUFFLED). No hidden scan over thresholds, subgroups, seeds, or horizons was performed; the population is fully enumerated in a single deterministic pass (prereg stopping_rules -> no optional stopping).

correction.interpretation: Exactly ONE hypothesis survives family-wise correction, and it is the PRE-SPECIFIED PRIMARY (FLAGSHIP vs EXISTING_SUITE). The ablation and the two null controls correctly FAIL to reject. This is the opposite of a best-of-N artifact: the surviving result is the one preregistered in advance, and the failing variants are recorded rather than hidden.

prereg_multiple_testing_stance.prereg_rationale: The frozen protocol (multiple_testing_corrections) declares exactly ONE preregistered primary hypothesis with a single pre-specified threshold, so no family-wise/FDR correction is strictly required. This report ADDS the correction machinery as defence-in-depth: it demonstrates that even if the four tried variants are (conservatively) treated as a multiple-testing family, the primary conclusion is unchanged. This is consistent with, and does not amend, the frozen preregistration (no new prereg_id opened).

primary.name: FLAGSHIP_vs_EXISTING_SUITE
primary.prereg_ref: protocols/flagship_preregistration.yaml :: nulls.primary_null + baselines.comparator (clean-archive wheel contract vs status-quo gate suite)

no_cherry_pick_attestation.statement: The FINAL inference uses the PRE-SPECIFIED primary comparison (FLAGSHIP vs the preregistered EXISTING_SUITE null), fixed BEFORE any run in FLAGSHIP-PREREG-001. It is NOT a post-hoc best-of-N pick. All 4 tried variants and their raw decision statistics / p-values are recorded above; the three non-primary variants correctly fail to reject and are NOT reinterpreted as the headline result.

corrected_conclusion.detection_leg: The marginal-detection hypothesis (H1: D_marginal >= 1) SURVIVES family-wise (Holm-Bonferroni) and FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg) correction across the 4-member family: only the pre-specified FLAGSHIP comparison is rejected at alpha=0.05.
corrected_conclusion.verdict_leg: Surviving multiplicity correction does NOT upgrade the study verdict. FLAGSHIP-RQ-001 stays INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (per RES-008) because the SEPARATE preregistered reproducibility-at-S leg is unverified (the committed snapshot-S artifact reports 70 defects at a stale wheel_sha; no same-S rerun was executed). Reproducibility is ORTHOGONAL to multiplicity; the correction machinery neither addresses nor can rescue it.

honesty_note: No significant CORRECTED verdict is manufactured. The correction machinery documents and controls SELECTION BIAS in the marginal-detection claim (the primary is preregistered, not cherry-picked; selection_count=4 is recorded; ablations fail honestly). The study-level verdict remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, consistent with RES-008, and no SUPPORTED result is fabricated. The final holdout / frozen snapshot S is untouched by this analysis.
